g.title: AUD_QSP
g.text: Alcohol Use Disorder — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
drinking → ethanol PK → opioid/dopamine reinforcement → allostatic neuroadaptation → withdrawal & craving → drinking (closed loop)
21 mechanistic modules · 248 nodes · 403 edges · states carried as ODEs in aud_mrgsolve_model.R are drawn with a double border
